intro: The Temple of the Moon is an introductory quest in Darnassus where Sister Aquinne directs adventurers to seek out Priestess A'moora. The Sisterhood of Elune requires aid for a suffering ancient creature dwelling within the boughs of Teldrassil. It serves as the opening call to a solemn ritual of mercy.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A once great creature of the forest is in need of help, traveler.
There is a difficult task that must be done.
Please seek out Priestess A'moora; she will explain things to you. Find her to the southeast of here, inside the Temple of the Moon.
